title: Term width bounded by formula width
statement: Let a disjunctive normal form formula be a finite list of terms, each a conjunction of literals on distinct coordinates. Every term appearing in the formula has width at most the width of the formula, where the formula width is the maximum term width, or zero if the formula is empty.
hypotheses_covered: A DNF formula on n coordinates
A term T belonging to the formula
